name: morrow-computer-v1
scope: The owner's E2B template build of profile morrow.computer v1 (ADR-0029 item 1 and owner question 1; build order PR 8). Recorded after the owner runs the build in README.md with the owner's own E2B login: template_id is E2B's id of the template named `name`, the pin the broker creates from (apps/broker/src/runtime-e2b.ts e2bPinnedTemplate); build_id, envd_version and built_on come from the owner's `template list` output, which holds no secret. All four stay null until then, and the runtime switch cannot go on (build order PR 9 qualifies this exact build first). E2B starts a template's newest ready build and documents no create by build, so build_id is the build the qualification checked: a new build of the same template, or a changed recipe_sha256, needs a new record and a new qualification before the switch may stay on.
